Variable Matrix [DNA]

Krack’d Vision

A kaleidoscope filter over the visualizer, applied before Krack’d FX, live and in the export.

Krack’d FX

Runs on top of Krack’d Vision, live and in the export. Drag the Order list to choose the stacking: the top filter is applied last, over the rest. Click a group to open it.
TAP TO START

3D Volumetric Waveform Visualizer

Color Palette Select

Colors the visualizer when it is set to palette color. The interface takes its colors from Krack’d Theme.
Global, for every layer, on desktop and phones. The viewport and the export preview always show the final look; this sets how MP4 and MOV exports are converted and tagged so players and editors show the same colors. Images (PNG, GIF, WebP) are always sRGB.

Krack’d Theme

Theme
Font accent
On: the title color is picked from this theme’s palette (the swatches beside the theme). Off, or pick a color: your own title color.
Header animation
Animates the strip at the right of every module header, in this theme’s colors.
Target cursor
A dot and four corner brackets that spin slowly and snap to frame the module under the pointer, while the setting highlight marks the setting inside it. Mouse and trackpad only.
Setting highlight
Frames the setting under the pointer inside a module: a marching dashed outline, corner handles, pulsing specks and two circling comets.
Log bar
Every status line launches the rocket across the header, uncovering the galaxy effect as it flies; the text writes out 20 px behind it. While lines keep coming (stems, video, audio, exports) the galaxy keeps glowing beside the text, and a percentage fills the progress rule.
Motion
Logo
The header logo reacts to the selected layer’s audio: each beat steps its hue and flares its glow, and the overall level keeps a glow underneath.

Audio Input Calibration

Each dot is a 1/12-octave band showing its loudest FFT bin. Click a band (or its color box) to edit it; drag band edges. Linked edges move together.

Timeline & Waveform

You always hear the original mix. Stem sliders, mute and solo only change what drives the visuals. Drag a lane to loop, drag the ruler to scrub, drop audio here.
